title: Gjakova — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Gjakova: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Gjakova has a population of 40,000. A city in western Kosovo known for its historic bazaar (Çarshia e Madhe), the Hadum Mosque, and its traditional craftsmanship and music scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 138 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
